fiona: dropped a prototype for a 'Share as report' flow — packs a trace snapshot + selected frames + metadata into a single downloadable bundle and an expiring permalink. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/share-report-v1 :satellite: harry: interesting. two questions: where does 'Share as report' live? inline in the header or behind the kebab? and does it generate a file or just a link? ola: my take: make it a menu item in the overflow. primary header should remain focused on triage actions. 'Share as report' is power-user, but we need it discoverable — add keyboard shortcut Cmd+Shift+S and mention it in the kebab. devon: Implementation note: generating a bundle can be expensive. prefer async job that returns a download link and optionally emails the user. show a job card in UI with ETA. fiona: UX idea — two modes: 'Quick link' (small JSON payload, expires in 7 days) and 'Bundle' (ZIP with frames.csv + event.json + permalink). Quick link should be default for hosted. harry: microcopy: don't call it 'Export' — that conflicts with CSV/JSON verbs. Call it 'Share as report' and inside the modal be explicit: 'Quick link (temporary)' and 'Download bundle (ZIP)'. ola: accessibility: when a report job completes, announce via aria-live: 'Report ready: Report for trace 0xabc is ready. Press Enter to open.' Also badge the jobs list with the number of ready artifacts. a11y-bot: checklist: job notifications must be keyboard focusable and reachable in a dedicated 'Artifacts' tray. use role=alert for immediate announcements and polite aria-live for passive updates. ensure color contrast on status badges. trap focus in the share modal. devon: for large archives, we should include an estimated size and warn: 'This bundle is ~12MB — larger bundles may take longer to generate.' backend will return size estimates. fiona: permalink behavior: should 'Get link' create a user-scoped link by default (only accessible to org) and give an option 'Make link public (expiring)' with explicit warning copy. default: org-only. harry: one more: provide a pre-formatted 'Attach to ticket' button that copies a small text blob including trace id, permalink, and suggested reproduction steps. toast should read: 'Support snippet copied — paste into ticket'. ola: Keyboard nav: modal should be openable by shortcut, tabs cycle through inputs, Escape cancels, and once created job gets focus in artifacts tray. fiona: sample aria snippet for job ready: ```html
Report ready for trace 0xabc — press Enter to download.
``` a11y-bot: minor: ensure snackbar toasts are not the only communication; provide focusable job list entries. announce sizes and access level for links (org-only vs public). devon: backend will add endpoints: POST /reports (mode, fields), GET /reports/:id (status, approx_size_mb, download_url). will send a webhook on completion for integration. fiona: thanks — can we get a quick prototype with the modal copy and job-card states? I'll add copy variations for 'Attach to ticket' and the quick-link warning. harry: will review copy. ola: can you run an a11y quick-pass when mock's ready? ola: yes, will do. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
